Contract.title: The GRACE 5 kernel: settled semantics, three skills, five commands
Contract.Problem: The repository holds a scaffold and the founding decisions and nothing that runs: no method text, no schema, no skill, no command. The owner required a slim successor built from scratch and has ruled on its shape; the settled semantics, the skills and the kernel are unbuilt.
Contract.Change: The method document, its topic files, the XSD schemas, four worked examples with briefs, one deliberately defective brief, the conformance case list, a measurement proposal and the rationale ledger become the standing method under models/architecture. The grace5 CLI provides init, check, run, status and close as that method defines them. Three skills (prepare, execute, review) exist once and the harness packages are generated from them. A conformance suite proves every case in models/architecture/conformance.md.

Constraints.Constraint: Nothing is copied from GRACE 4 or its tooling; its tests are read as examples and counterexamples only.
The surface is exactly the one the method lists; no deferred proposal is implemented.
close refuses in the order and for the reasons stated there, naming the unmet obligation.
Every mechanism the kernel implements has a ledger entry with a removal criterion.
The kernel validates against the published XSD files themselves, not a second hand-written copy of their rules.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Pilots in other repositories, and release or publication of the package.
Defining the M2 measurement method, which belongs to the owner's separate measurement repository; models/architecture/m2-proposal.md is a proposal to it and no more.
Any read or write of GRACE 4 state, and any migration.

Acceptance.Criterion: Each of the five commands behaves as the method and its topic files state, on all three check kinds.
Every case in models/architecture/conformance.md has a conformance test that fails when the kernel accepts the case.

Every example contract validates against its XSD through the kernel, every example brief passes the fidelity rules of models/architecture/brief.md, and the brief under examples/defective-brief, which omits a protected path, is reported by check.
The Claude plugin, OpenPackage and plain skills packages are generated from the canonical skills with no drift, and models/architecture/cli-reference.md is generated from the help text.
The four example briefs suffice for approval without the contract, in the owner's judgement.

Manual.Procedure: The owner reads the four example briefs under models/architecture/examples (A to D) without opening their contracts and states for each whether it would have sufficed for approval. Any brief judged insufficient is recorded as failed with the reason.

Decisions.Decision: The CLI binary is named grace5.
Implementation is Bun and TypeScript; XSD validation uses the xmllint-wasm library as the one runtime dependency.
The method documents under models/architecture, drafted before this contract existed, are adopted by this change rather than by a separate one.

The change executes in the repository's single worktree with no new branch; the start run is written by hand at the scaffold commit because no kernel exists yet, and final evidence is produced by the kernel itself.
The brief is one self-contained HTML page for the owner to read, not XML; it is the only record without an XSD.
Review records are numbered review-n.xml and the approval record lists each check's definition hash, which the founding decisions left open.
